title: I have a PIXEL 9 and am trying to use Thunderbird For Android and failing to get it working.
creator: robweir
content: I am not getting ThunderBird for Android to work on my PIXEL 9 android phone. Version 21.0 Nothing has loaded for a few months. Not sure what is wrong but I do know Telus uses Google Mail Services and it is a pain inthe ass to logon without their interference. Might have to resort to setting up my account under Gmail but I do not want to. Frustrated Robert
